what: Anheuser-Busch InBev is the world's largest brewer, with Budweiser, Corona, Stella Artois, Michelob Ultra and hundreds of local brands.
customers: Beer drinkers in more than 150 countries, through wholesalers, shops and bars.
moat: Leading market shares in many countries, global brands and very high margins from scale.
risks: Falling beer volumes in mature markets
